namespace = oe_dip2

# Event 1: Cipher Intercept Exposed (密信破译行动泄密)
oe_dip2.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_dip2.1.title
	desc = oe_dip2.1.desc
	outcome = negative
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_dip2_cipher_chamber.dds"

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_cipher_target } }
			random_neighbor_country = {
				limit = { country_exists = this is_rebel_country = no }
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_cipher_target
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_cipher_target }
			scope:oe_dip2_cipher_target = {
				add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_dip2_b_cipher_exposed }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_dip2.1.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_dip2.1.a.tt
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_scandal years = 2 mode = replace }
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_dip2.1.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_dip2.1.b.tt
		add_prestige = -15
		add_gold = -35
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}
}

# Event 7: Dynastic Succession Ultimatum (跨国王朝继承权通牒)
oe_dip2.7 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_dip2.7.title
	desc = oe_dip2.7.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_dip2_royal_hostage.dds"

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_claimant_power } }
			random_neighbor_country = {
				limit = { country_exists = this is_rebel_country = no }

	option = {

			scope:oe_dip2_claimant_power = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_dynastic_guarantor years = 10 mode = replace }

	option = {
		name = oe_dip2.7.b

			limit = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_claimant_power }

				add_gold = 120
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_dip2.7.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_dip2.7.c.tt
		add_prestige = 10
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_dynastic_rift years = 5 mode = replace }

# Event 8: Disposition of the Royal Hostage (皇室质子处置裁决)
oe_dip2.8 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_dip2.8.title
	desc = oe_dip2.8.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_dip2_royal_hostage.dds"

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_hostage } }
			random_character = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					has_variable = oe_dip2_hostage_home
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_hostage
				var:oe_dip2_hostage_home ?= { save_scope_as = oe_dip2_hostage_origin }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_dip2.8.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_dip2.8.a.tt
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_hostage }
			scope:oe_dip2_hostage = { oe_dip2_return_hostage_home = yes }
		}
		add_prestige = 15
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_hostage_goodwill_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_hostage_origin }
			scope:oe_dip2_hostage_origin = {
				add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_dip2_b_ransom_goodwill }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_dip2.8.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_dip2.8.b.tt
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_hostage }
			scope:oe_dip2_hostage = { oe_dip2_return_hostage_home = yes }
		}
		change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = 4.0 min = 120 max = 1000 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_hostage_origin }
			scope:oe_dip2_hostage_origin = {
				add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_dip2_b_dynastic_meddling }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_dip2.8.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_dip2.8.c.tt
		add_prestige = -2
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
	}
}

# Event 10: W1 Read-Only Audit Telemetry (Dev Panel Page 75)
oe_dip2.10 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_dip2.10.title
	desc = oe_dip2.10.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_diplomacy.dds"

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_dip2_ops_count }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_ops value = var:oe_dip2_ops_count }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_ops value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_dip2_granary_active_flag }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_granary value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_granary value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_dip2_coinage_active_flag }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_coinage value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_coinage value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_bureau_mod }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_bureau value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_bureau value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dip2_whisper_network }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_whisper value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_whisper value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_advantage }
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_cipher value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_cipher value = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_hostages value = 0 }
		every_character = {
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
				has_variable = oe_dip2_hostage_home
			}
			root = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_dip2_rd_hostages add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_dip2.10.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_dip2.10.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}
